article.title: Constructive Criticism Of Judiciary Necessary Feature Of Vibrant Democracy, But It Must Be Voiced In Appropriate Forum : Supreme Court

iterations.label: v1 qualifiers
iterations.note: The original schema. Six qualifier fields per fact, a per-fact depth loop, and a single paragraph from a different article.

iterations.label: v2 laya
iterations.note: A local decision model asked the atomicity question directly, at 1.0-1.5s per question and 1.15GB resident. Evaluated, then left out of the pipeline in favour of the LLM judge.

iterations.label: v3 per-fact
iterations.note: One LLM call per fact rather than per paragraph, with an evidence quote on every fact checked against the source text.

iterations.label: v4 batched + evidence
iterations.note: Batched the judge and split into a single call per depth level, and made the grounding check case-insensitive. Evidence was snapped to the overlapping sentence.

iterations.label: v5 no evidence
iterations.note: The evidence field was dropped, leaving facts as plain text with grounding and dedupe as the only automated filters. The cheapest configuration of the five.

ablation.label: drop the split step
ablation.lost: 7 atomic child facts, every compound fact unresolved

ablation.label: drop the extract stage
ablation.lost: nothing downstream can run; extraction is generative

ablation.label: a 100M policy clears all-atomic paragraphs
ablation.lost: this is the saving a local policy would chase
